style_en: Japanese TV anime style, crisp clean line art, cel-shaded coloring, calm muted colors, bright even lighting, ancient Japan Kofun-period clothing (mizura hair loops, kinu tunic, hakama trousers). Background must be pure white.
avoid_en: text, letters, logos, modern buildings or clothes, Chinese-style robes, nudity, blood, a second separate person

umisachi.desc_en: Umisachihiko (Hoderi), the elder brother, a sturdy fisherman god of ancient Japan about 30 years old, sun-tanned skin, a short neat black beard, black hair tied in mizura loops beside both ears, an indigo Kofun-period kinu tunic with a white rope sash and white hakama trousers tied below the knees, a string of white shell beads, barefoot, a stern proud face

yamasachi.desc_en: Yamasachihiko (Hoori), the younger brother, a slim young hunter god of ancient Japan about 20 years old, clean-shaven gentle face, black hair tied in mizura loops beside both ears, a moss-green Kofun-period kinu tunic with a brown leather sash and pale hakama trousers tied below the knees with red cords, a green magatama bead necklace, barefoot

toyotama.desc_en: Toyotamahime, the daughter of the sea god, a graceful young woman about 18 years old, very long black hair loosely tied at the back, a pale sea-green Kofun-period kinu tunic over a long white mo skirt, a sheer pale blue scarf over the shoulders, a necklace of pearls and blue jewels, calm deep eyes

watatsumi.desc_en: Watatsumi, the old god of the sea, a dignified elderly man with a long white beard and long white hair tied at the top, a deep blue Kofun-period robe with wave patterns and a white sash, a necklace of large pearls, kind but solemn face
